text_block_list.text:
Defying the crowd's expectations of a 
three-peat for Mejiro McQueen, Rice Shower 
seized victory.

Having received countless congratulatory 
messages from fans and friends, Rice 
Shower is deeply moved to realize she 
brought smiles to everyone's faces.

Mejiro McQueen gently nudged her forward, 
inviting her to join the Winning Live.

To express her gratitude to the fans who 
cheered for her, Rice Shower headed toward 
the Winning Live stage.
